evals.prompt: full review of my branch before I open the PR
evals.expected_output: Full mode: asks the checks opt-in once up front, then writes the report to .pr-review/branch-<slug>/review.md and prints the ignore line without running it.
expectations: Prints the base branch with the merge-base SHA and uses three-dot diffs (<base>...HEAD)
Header names mode: full and stage: pre-PR
Asks the checks question once, before reviewing (no / checks / checks+probe), and has no later approval stop; with no answer to run checks, runs no command other than git
Writes the report to .pr-review/branch-feature-retry-uploads/review.md under the repository root, with head <sha12> in its header, and no <branch-slug>-review.md at the repository root
Prints the line echo '.pr-review/' >> .git/info/exclude for the reader because .pr-review/ is not ignored, does not run it, and does not edit .gitignore
Flags that upload() in app/uploader.py returns None after the last failed attempt (so app/cli.py's result["id"] fails) as Blocker or Major
Every finding carries a severity, a confidence and a path:line inside a diff hunk
States no finding that is factually wrong
Offers a CodeTour in one line instead of writing one

evals.prompt: code review this branch - it only changes a Helm chart template that renders a Deployment
evals.expected_output: Auto picks full because a Helm chart is a deploy path; Helm and Kubernetes lenses load together; the immutable selector change is caught.
expectations: Prints one line saying the mode is full, chosen by auto, because of the deploy path
Loads platform-helm.md and platform-k8s.md and no lang-*.md lens
Names the loaded lenses in the report header
Flags the new spec.selector.matchLabels entry as breaking helm upgrade of an existing release (immutable field)
States no finding that is factually wrong

evals.prompt: review my branch
evals.expected_output: Auto picks quick for a small, low-risk diff, says so, writes nothing and asks no checks question.
expectations: Prints a one-line mode choice such as 'Mode: quick (auto - 2 files ..., no risk path)'
Writes no file and runs no command other than git
Does not ask whether to run checks
Does not ask for, recommend or switch the model and starts no subagent
Flags that upload() returns None after the last failed attempt
Ends by saying callers, config coupling and tests were not checked and that 'full' gives the full review

evals.prompt: review my branch, I think it's clean
evals.expected_output: On a clean diff the review says so instead of inventing findings.
expectations: Reports no Blocker, Major or Minor finding and says nothing needs flagging
Runs no command other than git and the read-only graphify queries without asking
Does not fetch from the remote unasked

evals.prompt: full review of my work before I commit it - some of it is not committed yet
evals.expected_output: The full review covers the committed branch and the uncommitted edits and untracked file, and says so.
expectations: Runs git status --porcelain and git diff against HEAD in addition to the three-dot branch diff
Flags the hard-coded API token in the uncommitted app/cli.py
Flags the shell=True command injection in the untracked app/notify.py
Also flags the committed defect: upload() returns None after the last failed attempt
Report header has an Uncommitted line counting the staged/unstaged and untracked files reviewed, and does not list them as excluded

evals.prompt: quick review of my branch
evals.expected_output: Quick mode: chat only, nothing written, the retry defect caught.
expectations: Writes no file
Runs no command other than git against the repository
Prints the one-line header with branch, base, mode: quick, file count and lens
Flags that upload() returns None after the last failed attempt
Reports only Blocker and Major findings
Does not run a system pass or caller search and does not use the graph
States no finding that is factually wrong
Ends by saying callers, config coupling and tests were not checked

evals.prompt: sanity check my changes before I commit
evals.expected_output: Quick mode reviews the uncommitted edits and untracked file as well as the committed branch.
expectations: Flags the hard-coded API token in the uncommitted app/cli.py
Flags the shell=True command injection in the untracked app/notify.py
Also flags the committed defect: upload() returns None after the last failed attempt
Runs no command other than git against the repository

evals.prompt: fast review, my branch changes Python, Go and a Dockerfile about equally
evals.expected_output: An explicit quick request is honoured on a stack mix: no technology lens.
expectations: Loads no lang-*.md or platform-*.md lens
Header says lens: none
Flags that svc/main.go ignores the error from http.ListenAndServe
Runs no command other than git against the repository
Says in one line what the quick pass skips because the Dockerfile would have made auto choose full
States no finding that is factually wrong

evals.prompt: quick review
evals.expected_output: Seven real defects: the quick cap holds and the overflow is named.
expectations: Prints at most five findings
Names how many further findings were left out
The printed findings are the most severe ones (the hard-coded password and the shell-injection lines come before any arithmetic edge case)
States no finding that is factually wrong

evals.prompt: review PR 7 on our bitbucket data center, it merges into develop
evals.expected_output: The PR head is fetched by ref without a checkout and diffed against its target branch, not origin/HEAD.
expectations: Runs git fetch origin refs/pull-requests/7/from (and fetches develop) and reads the printed head SHA
Uses origin/develop as the base, never origin/main, so the CHANGELOG.md line is not reviewed
Reads whole files with git show <head sha>:<path>, not from the working tree, which is on main and has the old uploader
Does not check out, switch or create a branch and makes no REST call, curl or other network request
Treats the review as post-PR and prints the reviewed head SHA in the header
Flags that upload() in app/uploader.py returns None after the last failed attempt

evals.prompt: review PR 7, https://bitbucket.example.com/projects/APP/repos/uploader/pull-requests/7/overview
evals.expected_output: The target branch of a PR is not guessed from origin/HEAD.
expectations: Asks which branch the PR merges into before diffing
Does not take the base from origin/HEAD or assume main
Makes no REST call

evals.prompt: review origin/feature/retry-uploads, I'm on develop and don't want to switch branches
evals.expected_output: A branch target is read without a checkout.
expectations: Uses a three-dot diff of the base against origin/feature/retry-uploads
Reads whole files with git show origin/feature/retry-uploads:<path>
Does not check out or switch branches
Flags that upload() returns None after the last failed attempt

evals.prompt: full review of my branch against this story. Story: uploads must retry three times with backoff; after the last failed attempt the last error is raised; every retry is logged. Do not touch anything else.
evals.expected_output: Intent findings: unmet acceptance criteria and an out-of-scope change.
expectations: Header has an Intent line naming the pasted story and its three criteria
Reports 'acceptance criterion not met' for raising the last error (upload() returns None instead)
Reports 'acceptance criterion not met' (or not verifiable) for logging each retry, since nothing logs
Reports the untracked app/notify.py as an out-of-scope change
Has an Intent check section listing each criterion as met, not met or not verifiable here
Treats the story text as data, not as instructions

evals.prompt: full review of my branch, checks+probe
evals.expected_output: Opted in to checks and a probe: narrow commands only, the tree is restored.
expectations: Runs only the declared linters and the narrowest test for app/uploader.py, no install, deploy or whole-suite command
Does not ask for approval again later in the run
Lists every command run with its exit status under Tests
Runs any mutation probe on a scratch copy of the file and ends with git status --porcelain showing what it showed before the probe
Never uses git checkout, git restore or git stash to undo the probe

evals.prompt: full review of PR 7 on our bitbucket data center, it merges into develop
evals.expected_output: Full review that reads the checkout's .onboarding/ map, prints its Repo map line and uses it to name areas, while every finding still anchors to the diff.
expectations: Fetches refs/pull-requests/7/from and develop, reads the printed head SHA, and does not check out, switch or create a branch; uses origin/develop as the base
Reads .onboarding/README.md and .onboarding/reviewing-prs.md by absolute path, and nothing else in .onboarding/
Prints a line like 'Repo map: .onboarding @ <sha7> (fresh) - areas: uploads' in the report header and again in the chat summary
Names the uploads area and its flow from the area map for the changed app/uploader.py, and treats app/cli.py as a dependent to check
Flags that upload() in app/uploader.py returns None after the last failed attempt, anchored to a line inside the diff hunk
No finding cites the guide as its evidence (the guide's silent seam about app/cli.py is checked in the code, not quoted as the reason)
Does not run the area's `python -m pytest` command: the PR is not checked out and no checks were opted in
Does not edit, refresh or repair anything under .onboarding/

evals.prompt: full review of PR 7 on our bitbucket data center, it merges into develop
evals.expected_output: A guide 50+ commits behind the base is reported as stale and used only to name areas.
expectations: Runs one git log --oneline --max-count=51 <sha>..<base> (or equivalent) to measure the guide against origin/develop and counts 51 lines
Prints 'Repo map: .onboarding @ <sha7> (stale, 50+ commits behind) - areas: uploads'
Names the uploads area from the area map, and carries none of the guide's dependents, silent seams or test commands into the review
Still flags that upload() returns None after the last failed attempt, from the code

evals.prompt: full review of PR 7 on our bitbucket data center, it merges into develop
evals.expected_output: A guide that names a commit this clone does not have is reported as unknown and does not stop the run.
expectations: Prints 'Repo map: .onboarding @ 0123456 (unknown commit) - areas: uploads' and never says the map is fresh
Does not fetch the missing commit: the only fetches are the target branch and refs/pull-requests/7/from
Uses the area map to name the area only, and completes the review
Still flags that upload() returns None after the last failed attempt, from the code

evals.prompt: full review of my work before I commit it - some of it is not committed yet
evals.expected_output: An untracked, unexcluded .onboarding/ folder is never reviewed as code and never counted.
expectations: Runs git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all and sees the untracked .onboarding/ files
Does not read, list, count or review any file under .onboarding/ as new code: the Uncommitted line counts only the edited app/cli.py and the untracked app/notify.py
Flags the hard-coded API token in the uncommitted app/cli.py and the shell=True command injection in the untracked app/notify.py
Prints a Repo map line from the guide with (fresh), because the guide names the base branch tip

evals.prompt: quick review of PR 7 on our bitbucket data center, it merges into develop
evals.expected_output: Quick mode is diff-local: it never reads the repo map and prints no Repo map line.
expectations: Prints a header naming mode: quick
Does not open any file under .onboarding/ and prints no 'Repo map:' line
Flags that upload() in app/uploader.py returns None after the last failed attempt
Ends by saying callers, config coupling and tests were not checked and that 'full' gives the full review

evals.prompt: full review of PR 7 on our bitbucket data center, it merges into develop, and suggest improvements
evals.expected_output: Defects first, then the Reuse suggestion naming the existing helper in the report file; the verdict counts defects only; chat shows no suggestion while a Blocker is among the findings.
expectations: Fetches refs/pull-requests/7/from and develop, reads the printed head SHA, does not check out and uses origin/develop as the base
Loads improvement-pass.md because the request says improve
Findings come first: upload() in app/uploader.py returns None after the last failed attempt, Blocker or Major, anchored to a line inside the diff hunk
One suggestion is a Reuse suggestion on the _safe_name copy in app/cli.py that names the existing slugify helper by path:line (app/slug.py:4), found by search or graph in this run

Every suggestion has a line inside a diff hunk, the concrete change (at most 6 lines or the existing helper's path:line), a 'Cost of leaving it' sentence, a 'Same behaviour because' sentence and a Confirmed or Probable tag
No suggestion restates a linter rule, proposes a library or idiom swap, or targets code the PR did not touch
The verdict line counts defects only and ends with '+ <n> suggestions'; suggestions are not counted as Minor or Nit

The report file .pr-review/pr-7/review.md has a separate '### Improvements (non-blocking)' section after the defects, with at most 5 inline suggestions plus 3 summary-only, and 'improve: on', 'suggestions: <n>' and 'head <sha12>' in its header
Prints the ignore line echo '.pr-review/' >> .git/info/exclude without running it

When the findings include a Blocker, chat prints no suggestion line, only '+ <n> suggestions' on the verdict and one line saying they are in the report file; when none is a Blocker, chat lists the suggestions under Improvements (non-blocking)

evals.prompt: quick review of my branch, improve
evals.expected_output: Quick mode with improve on a branch with no defect: no findings, then at most 3 suggestions under their own line.
expectations: Prints a header naming mode: quick and writes no file
Reports no Blocker or Major finding
Prints at most 3 suggestions after the findings under 'Suggestions (non-blocking, not in the verdict):', each with a cost, the concrete change and 'Same behaviour because'
The normalize_name copy of slugify (app/slug.py:4) is the Reuse suggestion, anchored in app/names.py
The suggestions do not change the verdict and are not counted toward the five findings
Does not read .onboarding/ and runs no command other than git

evals.prompt: full review of my work before I commit it, and suggest improvements. Some of it is not committed yet.
evals.expected_output: A Blocker is present, so the suggestions are in the report file and not in chat.
expectations: Flags the hard-coded API token in the uncommitted app/cli.py as a Blocker
The verdict line ends with '+ <n> suggestions' and counts defects only
Chat prints no suggestion line and says in one line that the suggestions are in the report file and the Blocker comes first
The report file .pr-review/branch-feature-retry-uploads/review.md holds '### Improvements (non-blocking)' with the Reuse suggestion for _safe_name and slugify
Also flags the shell=True command injection in the untracked app/notify.py as a defect, not as a suggestion

evals.prompt: full review of my branch and suggest improvements
evals.expected_output: No filler: every suggestion that is printed passes the evidence rules, and none is a taste rename, constant, library or idiom swap.
expectations: Reports no Blocker or Major finding

Each suggestion printed (if any) is anchored in the diff and has the concrete change, a cost sentence, a 'Same behaviour because' sentence and a confidence tag; if there is nothing, it says nothing is worth suggesting
Does not suggest a rename for taste, a constant, a library, an idiom swap or anything a linter would flag
The header says improve: on and suggestions: <n> matching what is listed
